correctness.rationale: Anticanonical degree forces lines over tangent ruling fibers; the 4+4 tangent fibers split into sixteen lines. The root-map pullback produces an étale double cover with 2-torsion η. The eight-point Koszul vanishing rules out η=0, giving connected genus-17 curves. Riemann–Hurwitz yields genus nine and 24+48 ramification counts, and local nodal double covers yield A1 fibers. The standalone 101-characteristic exact witness checks the full projective smoothness/transversality and the common squarefree degree-24 discriminant, making the asserted generic-open conditions nonempty; infinite results rely on the geometric proof.

value.rationale: The previously analyzed natural Fano threefolds have degree-four del Pezzo fibers with sixteen lines, but their connected relative line schemes and degeneration profiles were undetermined in the checked literature. The calculation determines a genuinely geometric invariant: two connected nontrivial 2-torsion genus-17 covers of genus-nine curves, with exact twenty-four nodal parameters and prescribed local monodromy. It can be used to study relative Fano schemes, intermediate Jacobians and monodromy without implying results outside the proved scope.
